high_level_description: The image depicts a woman walking her dog on a city street. The woman is dressed casually yet stylishly, wearing a white crop top that reveals her midriff, paired with high-waisted blue jeans. She accessorizes with a snakeskin-patterned crossbody bag, a gold watch, hoop earrings, and sunglasses. Her hair is long and dark, styled straight. She is holding the leash of a black and tan dog, which appears to be a German Shepherd mix. The dog has a red collar and is looking towards the camera. The woman is also holding a phone in one hand and a small object in the other.
